headline: Collate Lobby curates fictional 1930s hotel suite to launch its first editions collection
context: Over 30 designers, makers and studios have created limited-edition and prototype furniture and objects for Lobby, a new design platform launched by recruitment agency Collate Form during London Design Festival. Collate Lobby's debut exhibition takes the form of a fictional hotel

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Over 30 designers, makers and studios have created limited-edition and prototype furniture and objects for Lobby, a new design platform launched by recruitment agency Collate Form during London Design Festival. Collate Lobby's debut exhibition takes the form of a fictional hotel suite and foyer, inspired by the fashion and interiors of the 1930s.
